stateController.primary: ChatRouteState + HostChatScreenState + ChatReadMarkerController + ChatScrollCoordinator + ChatThreadActionController + ChatRetryController + ChatController
stateController.notes: Match Chat uses the shared ChatScreen. ChatRouteState performs uid, match, messages, public-profile, event, Suvbot action, mutation-pending, and share-controller provider watches before rendering. HostChatScreenState, despite its legacy name, owns consumer match identity, action availability, route/message/Suvbot retry intents, disabled composer copy, safety target copy, and message peer name. ChatThreadLookupState owns other-participant/profile/event/Suvbot lookup keys. ChatReadMarkerController executes read-marker side effects from ChatReadMarkerState decisions, ChatScrollCoordinator owns initial/appended/send-success auto-scroll, ChatThreadActionController executes profile/share/report/block typed actions, and ChatRetryController executes typed provider invalidation. ChatScreen owns local text entry and UI primitives while ChatController/SuvbotController own writes, image upload cleanup, report/block, and demo actions.
